description: Create or replace a named database schedule that runs SQL statements repeatedly on a timer, as the application's own runtime role, so row-level security applies. Send exactly one of cron (five-field UTC expression) or every_seconds (60 to 2678400). Each run is cancelled after timeout_ms (1000 to 30000, default 10000). Statements run in order and must be safe to repeat: write idempotent statements. Destructive: requires confirmed: true. A project whose Stop budget is reached has its schedules disabled automatically, within about an hour of the billed usage reaching the budget: the credit service does this after its hourly pgcf pass, and Continue budgets are never touched. While the budget is reached, schedule set with enabled true and schedule run are refused with project_budget_exceeded (HTTP 402). Re-enabling is manual: raise the budget (or wait for the next UTC month) and run database schedule set --enabled true again with the schedule body (read it with schedule get).

profile_name.description: Saved login to act as (profile_list shows them). Needed only when several logins could run this call; OHMYHOST_PROFILE of this server must match it.
